chains.format: chromatic-scale files 16-bit/44.1 kHz .mono (centre mic) and .stereo; 24-bit/96 kHz single notes in zips
chains.room: anechoic chamber, Wendell Johnson Speech and Hearing Center, University of Iowa
chains.notes: MIS.html: three QTC-40 in a Decca tree, left/centre/right 12 inches apart, 5 feet in front; the centre mic was downsampled to the 16/44.1 mono chromatic scales; left and right were edited into single-note stereo 24/96 files. The derivation of the .stereo chromatic-scale files is not documented.

chains.room: anechoic chamber, Wendell Johnson Speech and Hearing Center, University of Iowa
chains.notes: 2013 percussion sessions publish stereo only; which microphones feed left and right is not stated on the page. MISPost2012Intro.html (https://theremin.music.uiowa.edu/MISPost2012Intro.html, read 2026-10-21) says the percussion instruments were done between March and June 2013 at a 24-bit, 44.1 kHz format with 3 Earthworks QTC40 microphones in a Decca Tree configuration; the same page describes mid-side processing applied 'whenever possible' to widen the stereo field of the files it edits (it describes the ff files); this note does not claim the mf files graded here were so processed. MISxylophone.html (session of 10 June 2013, Earthworks QTC40, Metric Halo 2882, 24-bit 44.1 kHz stereo, 5 feet) has sections 'Hard Rubber Mallets' and 'Rosewood Mallets', so 'rosewood' in the file names xylophone.rosewood.* names the MALLETS; the page gives Model NA and states neither the bar material nor whether resonators were present.
